coverage.footprint_note: Product footprints, not all-variable usable land; overlapping regions counted once in union.

limitations: Purposive sites, not ground-truth analog validation.
4 km metadata averages can hide subcell variation; fine/coarse disagreement is measured.
Earth MODIS clear-sky composite temperatures and planetary models are approximate comparisons.
Footprint union includes missing evidence and water; score areas are nominal and regions can overlap.
